values: 对前方快速造成多次伤害，随后突进至区域末端，并再次造成伤害。
Sonja repeatedly attacks enemies within a designated frontal area, dealing damage multiple times before charging to the end of the targeted area to deal damage again.
选择一个方向，对前方3格长、3格宽的范围内的敌人进行8次神速刺击，每次造成35% + 4% ATK伤害。随后快速突进至该区域末端，并再次对该区域内所有敌人造成180% + 20% ATK伤害。本技能的每次伤害都会附带目标当前生命值4%的额外伤害，最高不超过自身攻击力的160%。本技能释放期间，索尼娅免疫控制效果。

Sonja delivers 8 Piercing Strikes on enemies in a designated frontal area (3-tile wide and 3-tile long), each dealing 35% + 4% ATK damage. Each strike also deals extra damage equal to 4% of the enemy's current HP, up to 160% of Sonja's own ATK. She then charges to the far end of the struck area, dealing 180% + 20% ATK damage to enemies within it. While casting this skill, Sonja is immune to all control effects.
每次神速刺击造成的伤害提高至40% + 4% ATK。
Increases the damage of each Piercing Strike to 40% + 4% ATK.
每次神速刺击造成的伤害提高至45% + 4% ATK。
Increases the damage of each Piercing Strike to 45% + 4% ATK.
每次神速刺击造成的伤害提高至50% + 4% ATK。
Increases the damage of each Piercing Strike to 50% + 4% ATK.
最后一击的伤害提高至220% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of Sonja's charge to 220% + 20% ATK.
战斗开始时与左右各一名友军签订誓约，使其不断提高属性值。
Sonja forms a pact with allies on her left and right when a battle starts, continuously increasing their stats.

战斗开始时，选择布阵在自己左侧和右侧相邻位置的各一名友军，与之建立“血薇誓约”（优先选择其中布阵更靠前的友军），并使这两名友军立即提升10% + 1%攻击力、15% + 1.5%护甲与魔抗。本技能释放期间，索尼娅免疫控制效果。“血薇誓约”存续时，这两名友军每6秒还会额外提升3% + 0.3%攻击力、4% + 0.4%护甲与魔抗，最多叠加6层。
当任意一名“血薇誓约”成员被击败时，“血薇誓约”将立即终结，同时索尼娅将会收回并获得所有“血薇誓约”成员身上已经累积的这部分属性加成，持续至战斗结束。

When a battle starts, Sonja forms Crimson Covenant with two allies placed to her left and right (prioritizing those in the front over those in the back), increasing their ATK by 10% + 1% and their Phys & Magic DEF by 15% + 1.5%. While Crimson Covenant is active, the two allies gain an extra 3% + 0.3% ATK and 4% + 0.4% Phys & Magic DEF every 6s, stacking up to 6 times. Sonja is immune to all control effects while casting this skill.
Crimson Covenant is terminated if either of the buffed allies is defeated. In this case, Sonja absorbs the accumulated stat bonuses from both allies, gaining them for herself until the battle ends.
建立誓约时，友军获得的攻击力比例提高至13% + 1%、护甲与魔抗比例提高至18% + 1.5%。
Increases Crimson Covenant's initial ATK bonus to 13% + 1%, and its initial Phys & Magic DEF bonus to 18% + 1.5%.
后续每隔6秒，友军额外获得的攻击力比例提高至4% + 0.3%、护甲与魔抗比例提高至5% + 0.4%。
Grants allies with Crimson Covenant an extra 4% + 0.3% ATK and 5% + 0.4% Phys & Magic DEF every 6s.
建立誓约时，友军获得的攻击力比例提高至16% + 1%、护甲与魔抗比例提高至21% + 1.5%。
Increases Crimson Covenant's initial ATK bonus to 16% + 1%, and its initial Phys & Magic DEF bonus to 21% + 1.5%.
对周围的敌人造成两次伤害和眩晕。
Sonja deals damage and stuns nearby enemies twice.
挥舞披风，对周围1格范围内的敌人造成两次120% + 10% ATK伤害，并且每次附带1 + 0.1秒眩晕。
Sonja spins, slashing enemies within 1 tile twice with her cloak. Each slash deals 120% + 10% ATK damage and stuns the enemies hit for 1 + 0.1s.
本技能每次造成的伤害量提高至130% + 10% ATK。
Increases the damage of each slash to 130% + 10% ATK.
本技能每次造成的伤害量提高至140% + 10% ATK。
Increases the damage of each slash to 140% + 10% ATK.
每次附带的眩晕时间延长至1.5 + 0.1秒。
战斗中，自身的急速提升7.2点，且当自己首次释放终极技能之后，自身的急速额外提升7.2点。
Sonja increases her Haste by 7.2 during battle. She gains an extra 7.2 Haste after casting Tempest Thrusts for the first time.
战斗中，自身的急速提升9.6点，且当自己首次释放终极技能之后，自身的急速额外提升9.6点。
Sonja increases her Haste by 9.6 during battle. She gains an extra 9.6 Haste after casting Tempest Thrusts for the first time.
战斗中，自身的急速提升12点，且当自己首次释放终极技能之后，自身的急速额外提升12点。
Sonja increases her Haste by 12 during battle. She gains an extra 12 Haste after casting Tempest Thrusts for the first time.
首次释放终极技能后，“血薇誓约”将永久强化。
Sonja enhances Crimson Covenant after casting her first Tempest Thrusts.
额外获得100点初始能量。索尼娅首次释放终极技能后，将会使友方的“血薇誓约”永久强化：“血薇誓约”不再会终结，且索尼娅在其他“血薇誓约”成员存活期间也能实时共享其身上累积的这部分属性加成。

Sonja gains 100 extra Initial Energy. She permanently enhances Crimson Covenant after casting her first Tempest Thrusts. Instead of only gaining stat bonuses when a buffed ally is defeated, she continuously benefits from the accumulated stat bonuses while the buffed allies are alive.
“血薇誓约”获得永久强化之后，其中任意成员受到伤害时，若有其他“血薇誓约”成员存活，则原始伤害量将会降低40%，降低部分的50%将由其余“血薇誓约”成员分摊（不会导致分摊者被击败）。

Enhancing the Crimson Covenant also reduces damage taken by 40% for a covenant member if any other member is alive. 50% of the reduced damage is shared by other members, but this will not cause them to be defeated.
“血薇誓约”获得永久强化之后，成员之间相互分摊伤害的比例降低至40%。
Enhancing the Crimson Covenant also reduces damage shared by other members to 40% of the total amount reduced.
终极技能造成伤害量的一定比例将会转化为对自身的治疗。
Sonja converts some of the damage dealt by Tempest Thrusts into self-healing.
终极技能“回旋突刺”造成伤害的20%将立即转化为对索尼娅的治疗。
Sonja converts 20% of the damage dealt by Tempest Thrusts into self-healing.
